latest.notes:
A clock slot's tempo no longer outranks your separation rules.

It used to narrow the rotation before any song was chosen, which quietly made the tempo absolute: a Fast slot drawing on three fast songs kept choosing among those three, and broke your same-song separation to do it. A tempo that can be met is still met — but when the only way to keep it would be to air a song again inside your separation window, the hour drifts off its tempo map instead.

The log report now tells the two problems apart, because the fixes are different: 'no Fast songs — 24 slots asked for one' means the library has none of that tempo, while '3 Fast songs for 24 Fast slots' means the pool is too crowded. Both are reported once per rotation and tempo instead of once an hour, and where songs still have no BPM it says so — measuring them may be all it needs.
